registration.scope: Execution-aware passing only. Champion v9.1 frozen. No shooting, goalkeeper, defensive-cover helper or general movement changes.
registration.diagnostics: Previously used build11 development seeds, public native trajectories and actual actions. These are regression observations, never fresh evidence.
registration.features: Independent execution-law reception query, reception command continuity, first-touch quality and target stability where supported by cases. Screen separately before combining.
registration.development: 64 paired screen fixtures (8styles*2seeds*4arrangements), then240 paired fixtures (10styles*6seeds*4). Choose on points, then wins, goal difference, then runtime; never pass completion alone.
registration.fresh: 720 paired fixtures per source:15frozen known sources*12unused seeds*4arrangements. Freeze once before any fresh fixture; no fresh tuning.
registration.promotion: More fresh points and positive paired whole-seed bootstrap95%lower bound. Zero policy exceptions, no reproducible deadline failures. Mean decision<=champion*1.35+0.04ms; no more than2 additional raw deadline misses per1000fixtures. Otherwise retainv9.1.
registration.timing: Native20ms deadline throughout benchmarks. Preserve raw results. Repeat exact timeout-containing fixtures at most3times and accept first clean result regardless of score. No exception repairs.

actual_command_registration.motivation: Command continuity slightly reduced development points. Instead verify the actual live first command after cover/avoidance, preserving movement and canceling plans it cannot execute.
actual_command_registration.comparison: Compare independently against execution-only; screen before240development. No fresh data has been executed or inspected.

freeze.selection_basis: The task requires forecasts to respect actual issued movements and preserve defensive-cover/avoidance commands. Execution-only is a component ablation; priority-following overrides the named receiver command. Select the complete actual-command integration, then require the independent points/reliability gate before promotion.
freeze.excluded_features: Target holding lost points in the combined screen. First-touch filtering added no development points/wins/goals over execution-only. Command-priority following reduced development points and overrides the existing named receiver role command.
freeze.cleanup: Module documentation and version only; normalized decision AST exactly equal to tested role-aware prototype.
freeze.gate: More fresh points and positive paired whole-seed bootstrap95%lower bound. Zero policy exceptions, no reproducible deadline failures. Mean decision<=champion*1.35+0.04ms; no more than2 additional raw deadline misses per1000fixtures. Otherwise retainv9.1.
